description: Source code defining error handling types and functions for the CEL Go library, including custom error type Err, error constants, and utility functions for error creation and handling.

classes.name: Err
classes.description: Custom error type extending Go's error with additional NodeID field and implementing ref.Val interface.

methods.name: NewErr
methods.description: Creates a new Err with formatted message.

methods.name: NewErrFromString
methods.description: Creates a new Err with a simple string message.

methods.name: NewErrWithNodeID
methods.description: Creates a new Err with formatted message and associated NodeID.

methods.name: LabelErrNode
methods.description: Associates a NodeID with an Err if it doesn't already have one.

methods.name: NoSuchOverloadErr
methods.description: Returns a singleton error indicating no such overload.

methods.name: UnsupportedRefValConversionErr
methods.description: Returns an error for unsupported conversion to ref.Val.

methods.name: MaybeNoSuchOverloadErr
methods.description: Returns existing error or creates a no-overload error.

methods.name: ValOrErr
methods.description: Returns existing error or creates a new one based on validation.

methods.name: WrapErr
methods.description: Wraps a standard Go error into a CEL Err.

methods.name: ConvertToNative
methods.description: Converts Err to native Go type, returning the underlying error.

methods.name: ConvertToType
methods.description: Converts Err to a specified ref.Type, returns itself.

methods.name: Equal
methods.description: Checks equality with another ref.Val, errors are not equal to other values.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the type of the error, ErrType.

methods.name: Is
methods.description: Checks if the error matches a target error.
